title: Healthy project with mixed task statuses
input: Bundle for an active project with 1 done task, 1 doing task, 2 to-do tasks, no blocked tasks, one decision document and one recent meeting note.
pass_criteria: Output has all six required sections (Header, Summary, Progress, Next up, Risks & blockers, Asks); health judged on-track; Progress lists the done+doing tasks by title; Next up lists both to-do tasks; Risks says 'None identified.'; 150-350 words; no facts absent from the bundle.
